label: to review
Proposed: Franken
research: The archival abstract of a late-sixteenth-century copy names Elector Philipp, Michael Rosenberger and 60 gulden. The same-name receipt from the same register in 1507_3.json and the elector’s 1507 Duttweiler sale to his Oggersheim Schultheiß (1507-06-24.json) make that Schultheiß the probable recipient, with moderate confidence. The abstract gives no office, place or relative. The purpose of the 60-gulden receipt and its connection to the 80-gulden receipt remain open. The case for Franken follows the likely Bauland connection of the father named in 1497-03-21.json (compare 1490-10-28.json). The Rosenegg spelling parallel lacks similar evidence in this Palatine setting.
